_comment: Edit status to Tested when verified in-game. Edit name to rename a group. Add cards to cards array to reassign them. Re-run /feature-map Sirus23_Mod_Collection to refresh feature-map.md. 'confidence' is a separate axis from 'status' (see .audit/feature-map.md Confidence Legend) - it is not a manual annotation and is refreshed by /feature-map each run; do not hand-edit it.

groups.name: Sheep Lifecycle

Before publish the ram also carries the ewe's Wool bar and Shear interaction, and Tend Flock shears it (pending T2.530).
groups.evidence: T2.26 PASS (2026-07-21, wild ram breeding M3); GameLoadPatch.cs (implementing breeding) last touched 2026-07-04, before the pass — no material change since.

groups.name: Ox Cart
groups._note: NEW group (1.22.0, 2026-10-03). A hand-held container modelled on the vanilla Travois at twice its capacity, with the Travois's Movement Penalty gated off while a Bull (CowFreeMale) is on the board (W0-14 branch (a)); blueprint gated on a Bull. Borrows the Ox Plough's picture (ART PARTIAL). Since 1.22.6: MaxWeightCapacity 6000 (1.5x the Travois's 4000), unconditional; a Bull on the board cuts MovementPenalty from 2 to 1 and drops the CantHaulSoMuchPenalty +1, which is the vanilla two-large-carts movement block (status at 2), not a capacity change.
groups.evidence: Built 2026-10-03; no in-game or harness pass yet (T2.542 pending).

groups.name: Felt Dyeing

groups.evidence: T2.537 pending (filed 2026-10-02): read from the export, the decompile and a clean build, not yet seen in a running game; the tag name is the part the in-game row proves.

groups.name: Felt Set Bonus
groups._note: 1.22.0 (2026-10-03): a hidden runtime counter GameStat (sh_felt_outfit_pieces, 0 to 4) that each worn felt wearable raises by 1 through one PassiveEffect (OnlyWhenEquipped, EquippedOnBodyOnly), with one status at 3 to 4 adding +4 (a tunable placeholder) to vanilla Cold Resistance; one status on one stat is what makes the bonus apply once. 1.22.6 (S23-B18): the status and every garment now raise TemperaturePerceived (set bonus +1) instead of ColdResistance, an encoding stat whose exact-value statuses a +N breaks. No tag, no C#; the csproj gained a GameStat include.
groups.evidence: T2.540 pending (filed 2026-10-03): read from the base game's Skis pattern, the decompile and a clean build, not yet seen in a running game; whether the counter reads back after a cold load is the part the in-game row proves.
